simple.meaning: פַּרְשֵׁז (parshêz) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to expand.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Job, beginning at Job 26:9. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פַּרְשֵׁז (H6576) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: פַּרְשֵׁז (parshêz) / H6576 is traced through Job 26:9 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H6576. parsez מַּרְשֵׂז (Baer, שֵׁז - van d. H. Gi), Infinitive absolute Pi`lel (Ges § 56 ) from מָּרַשׂ (si vera lectio) ׳פ עֲנָנוֺ עָלָיו Job 26:9 a spreading his cloud upon it (but Bu Du and others read מָּרַשׂ מֹּרֵשׂ, , or פָרשֹׁ ).
definitions.rootNote: a root apparently formed by compounding 6567 and that of 6518 (compare 6574 );
